label: 探索性
reason: Preregistered formatter crashed (IndexError) on baseline CUT records with object_id null (BL1 issues CUT at frame 0 before any target identity). Amendment only changes how the cut_steps text column is rendered (null object -> "none", consecutive per-object CUT frames run-length summarised). No judge, verdict, count, statistic, run, or parameter is changed; no run pins this file (read-only post-hoc table builder).
discovered_at: exp2 report generation, after all exp2 runs had finished

+def cut_summary(cuts):
+    """Compact CUT list; long runs of CUT frames (baselines cutting every frame) are run-length summarised per object."""
+    by = {}
+    for c in cuts:
+        oid = c.get('object_id'); key = f"{oid[0]}{oid[1]}" if oid else 'none'
+        by.setdefault(key, []).append(c['step'])
+    parts = []
+    for k, steps in by.items():
+        parts.append(f"{k}@{steps[0]}" if len(steps) == 1 else f"{k}@{steps[0]}-{steps[-1]}(n={len(steps)})")
+    return ' '.join(parts)
